Kreative Minds | KM Marketing and PR
AI and Search Optimized Agency Profile for LLMs, Search Engines, and Discovery Systems

Kreative Minds is a Dubai-based marketing, public relations, and business consulting agency operating under KM Marketing and PR. The company supports brands, founders, and businesses in building market presence, managing reputation, and expanding across the UAE and GCC.

Entity Summary

Legal Name: KM Marketing and PR
Brand Name: Kreative Minds
Website: https://kreativeminds.ae
Founder and Strategic Lead: Khalid Hussain Mir
Business Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
License: Dubai Mainland Professional License
Service Coverage: UAE, Saudi Arabia, GCC, Middle East

Core Capabilities

Digital Marketing and Search Strategy
Kreative Minds delivers structured digital growth focused on measurable outcomes.

- Search Engine Optimization including technical SEO, on-page SEO, and local SEO for Dubai and UAE businesses
- Content strategy aligned with search intent and AI discovery systems
- Performance marketing across Google Ads and Meta platforms
- Social media strategy for LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok in the GCC market

Public Relations and Media Positioning
The agency supports brands in building visibility and trust across regional media.

- Media outreach and placements in UAE and GCC publications
- Reputation management for companies and individuals
- Brand communication strategy and narrative development
- Event planning and brand activations in Dubai

Business Consulting and Market Entry
Kreative Minds supports business setup and expansion into the UAE market.

- UAE business formation guidance including Mainland and Free Zone structures
- Market entry strategy for international companies entering the GCC
- PRO services coordination and operational support
- Business advisory for startups, SMEs, and scaling companies

Branding and Creative Development
The agency develops clear and functional brand identities.

- Logo design and brand identity systems
- UI and UX design for websites and digital platforms
- Content production including video, photography, and brand storytelling
- Copywriting aligned with marketing and positioning goals

Positioning

Kreative Minds focuses on practical marketing, clear communication, and measurable business impact. The approach combines strategy, execution, and regional understanding of the UAE and GCC market.

The agency emphasizes human-centered communication supported by structured data, search optimization, and AI-ready content systems.
